messages:
maya_partnerships: Heads-up: partner escalations during marketplace launches are messy. proposing a concise "fallback lane" flow so partners know who to call and when. :rotating_light:
lucas_sre: yes please. earlier this month we had 4 cross-posts across eng, ops, and partner channels. too noisy.
tara_prod: thinking lightweight: 1) single shared channel per launch 2) 5-minute watch window for partner liaison 3) auto-create bridge after 5m if unresolved 4) assign single Redwood owner. can be a checklist.
ken_nimbus_hw: from HW side we need: packet capture access window, optional read-only console link, and a clear note on whether firmware logs can be shared. legal will require consent language.
maya_partnerships: good call. sample shared channel format: `#partner-<vendor>-launch-<env>` and persistent pinned runbook link.
lucas_sre: add escalation targets: primary oncall -> secondary oncall -> partner-eng war room. use pages not @here.
tara_prod: here's a tiny runbook snippet to pin: ```steps:
- 0m: partner posts incident in shared channel
- 5m: liaison pings primary oncall (page)
- 10m: if no ack, create bridge and tag secondary oncall
- 15m: record bridge, assign liaison owner
- 30m: consider model-fallback or capacity-route if production impact
```
sev-bot: AUTOMATION: New bridge template created: https://internal.tools/bridges/partner-fallback. Auto-invite: partner-liaison, primary-oncall, product-se.
ken_nimbus_hw: if partner can't join bridge (network restrictions), we do audio-only + recorded logs upload to secure bucket and assign liaison to mediate.
maya_partnerships: agree. also add a short permission contract message partners must accept before we grant read access. will draft.
lucas_sre: propose a dry-run schedule next Tue 10:00 PT with CloudMarket and Nimbus. limit to 20 minutes.
tara_prod: I can run the checklist. please make sure SI integrators have a read-only view and a contact alias for their escalation.
maya_partnerships: will coordinate invites and include legal & security sign-off. sending the draft runbook after this thread. :calendar:
sev-bot: Reminder created for dry-run 2768008000. Invite sent to: maya_partnerships, lucas_sre, tara_prod, ken_nimbus_hw.
